lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Investigation or close reading: congruence defined by rigid motion

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows the kind of reasoning the investigation asks for.

items.prompt: Two sides and the included angle are congruent. Which criterion?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Talk through what changes and what stays fixed before you answer.

items.prompt: Two triangles share two pairs of congruent sides and a pair of congruent angles that are not between those sides. Why does this fail to prove congruence?
choices: The angle must be a right angle for any criterion to apply.
The unknown side can close the triangle in two different ways, producing one acute and one obtuse triangle from the same measurements.
Two sides are never enough information under any circumstances.
The triangles are congruent, but the criterion is simply named differently.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 70° and ∠B = 65°. Find ∠F.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A rigid motion is a transformation that …
choices: maps every figure to a similar figure
preserves area but may change side lengths
preserves shape but may change size

items.prompt: In two triangles, all three pairs of corresponding sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 23° and ∠B = 66°. Find ∠F.
Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 58° and ∠B = 72°. Find ∠F.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Write out the reasoning in full sentences. A correct answer with no justification does not count here.

items.prompt: If a sequence of rigid motions maps △ABC onto △DEF, then …
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and the pair of included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
